title: Full-Stack Blog Application
excerpt: A fully functional full-stack blog application featuring secure authentication, CRUD operations, and a custom responsive UI.
fullContent:
Excited to share my latest project: a fully functional, full-stack Blog Application! 🚀

Building this from the ground up was an incredible learning experience. I wanted to challenge myself to not just build a frontend, but to create a complete, end-to-end solution.

💻 Tech Stack:

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript
  • Backend: PHP (Custom REST API)
  • Database: MySQL

🔑 Key Features:

  • ✅ Secure user authentication (Login/Register with password hashing)
  • ✅ Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete blogs)
  • ✅ Strict authorization (users can only manage their own posts)
  • ✅ Integrated EasyMDE Markdown editor & Marked.js for dynamic rendering
  • ✅ Custom server-side caching for faster load times
  • ✅ Fully responsive, custom "Fashion & Design" UI

This project taught me so much about API routing, database security, handling live server deployments, and debugging environment configurations.

Check out the code on my GitHub here:
https://github.com/chathunikawiraj/Blog-Application.git

🌐 Live Demo:
https://fashion-design.infinityfreeapp.com/

title: Air Quality and Weather Prediction System
excerpt: A secure dual-station IoT platform for real-time environmental monitoring and short-term AI-based air quality and weather prediction.
fullContent:
🚀 Excited to share the successful completion of our project: Air Quality & Weather Prediction System!

To address the challenges of localized environmental monitoring and secure sensor-data transmission, our team, Sensor Squad, developed a secure dual-station platform for real-time environmental monitoring and short-term air quality and weather prediction.

🔹 Key Architectural Highlights

• Dual-Station Architecture
Built two physically separated monitoring stations: a Ground Station focused on air-quality parameters such as PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, VOC, NOx, CO₂, and CO, and a Rooftop Station monitoring weather parameters including temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, light intensity, and atmospheric pressure.

• Embedded & Hardware Systems
Powered by ESP32 microcontrollers, with custom PCB designs developed using EasyEDA, solar/battery power management, DS3231 RTC timestamping, and W25Q128 flash memory for local data buffering during network interruptions.

• End-to-End Security
Implemented AES-128-GCM authenticated encryption on the ESP32 using mbedTLS to protect sensor data during transmission through GSM/GPRS using the SIM800L. A Cloudflare Worker validates and decrypts the encrypted payload before securely forwarding the data to Firebase Realtime Database via HTTPS.

• AI/ML-Based Prediction
Developed a PyTorch-based Attention-Augmented LSTM pipeline for multi-target short-term forecasting of weather and air-quality parameters, including AQI-related predictions.

• Interactive Web Dashboard
Developed a responsive React.js dashboard hosted on Netlify, featuring real-time telemetry, historical data visualization, interactive Chart.js analytics, prediction results, and intelligent environmental alerts.

🔹 My Core Contributions

  • Architected and implemented the AES-128-GCM data-security mechanism on the ESP32 and developed the secure Cloudflare Worker middleware for authenticated decryption and Firebase integration.
  • Programmed the SIM800L GSM/GPRS module using UART and AT commands, including network configuration, HTTP communication, error handling, and reconnection mechanisms.
  • Integrated and tested the BMP280 atmospheric pressure sensor and MICS-5524 gas sensor with the ESP32.
  • Contributed to the cloud backend and database integration, ensuring reliable data transmission, storage, and synchronization with the web dashboard.

🌐 Live Dashboard:
https://lnkd.in/gxWuJ7qk

A huge thank you to my amazing team members and our project supervisor Ms. Lakdini Manchanayaka, for their collaboration and guidance throughout the project.

🛠️ Tech Stack
ESP32 | C/C++ | Arduino IDE | AES-128-GCM | mbedTLS | SIM800L GSM/GPRS | Cloudflare Workers | Firebase | React.js | Python | PyTorch | LSTM | EasyEDA
